intent_en: To illustrate the timing and severity of the sharp surge in daily confirmed coronavirus cases in India beginning in early 2021.
previous_intent: To illustrate the sharp increase in daily confirmed coronavirus cases in India that began in April 2021.
narration_support: It began in April 2021, when India experienced a sharp increase in coronavirus cases.
chart_support: Line chart displaying confirmed daily Covid-19 cases in India from March 2020 to April 2021, showing a dramatic vertical rise in cases starting in March 2021.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly identifies April 2021 as the start of a sharp increase, which corresponds directly to the steep upward trajectory seen in the line graph at the end of the timeline (March-April 2021).
